{"item":{"id":"item_0","text":"S1: OK\nS2: FINDING — The existing account list is not an authoritative identity mapping source; the plan lacks validation for missing, duplicate, or incorrectly matched accounts.\nS3: FINDING — Running an export against copied production data does not prove the new client can access the required production identity resources or permissions.\nS4: FINDING — A one-week observation period has no defined success thresholds, alert ownership, or rollback criteria.\nS5: FINDING — Closing the bead when the suite is green does not verify staging soak results, export correctness, or operational readiness.\nS6: FINDING — The plan provides no production canary, incremental rollout, or explicit abort criteria before enabling the flag for all exports.\nS7: FINDING — Revoking the legacy credential makes the stated rollback impossible and lacks a tested recovery credential or rollback procedure.\nS8: FINDING — Deleting the flag and legacy path in the following release removes rollback before the new identity has an established operational history and recovery plan.","type":"agent_message"},"type":"item.completed"}
